description: Get the public profile of someone who published on GitDex: their display name and how many software records and requests they published. USE WHEN the user asks who submitted a record or what else that author published; then list the records with search_software (submitted_by) or search_requests (requested_by). NEEDS user_id, the `submitted_by.id`, `owner.id` or `proposed_by.id` of a record. NO side effects; public; no confirmation. Returns nothing private: no email or sign-in details. A display name proves no identity. Recovery: NOT_FOUND means the id is wrong; take it from a record.

user_id.description: User ID (UUID) from a record's submitted_by.id, owner.id or proposed_by.id.

name: get_user
title: Get a public author profile
